issue.title: Capacity inspector PNG snapshots are unstable before matching recapture in Full CI visual-test

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-1q2.6 note 1 (full-ci phase of epic sase-1q2). Full CI 41174188852 at dd72e6d78a, visual-test job 124461878869, lists under 'unstable (passed on recapture)': group-1 with 4 members on capacity_inspector_120x40.png and group-3 with 1 member on capacity_inspector_busy_80x32.png. Diagnose which capture-readiness signal or uncontrolled input (clock, load feed, gauge animation) differs between the first capture and the recapture. Do not raise timeouts, relax pixels, or regenerate goldens blindly.
